fields.Brand Customer Promise: Travel basics done right—a restful stay with great savings backed by a nationally recognized brand, with clean rooms, free Wi-Fi, and fresh coffee every morning.
fields.Brand Value Proposition:
Guests: Covers the travel basics with peace of mind from Choice backing; fresh, clean rooms and complimentary Wi-Fi.

Owners: Access to Choice technology, distribution, and award-winning Choice Privileges; 600+ properties worldwide.

Choice: Economy-tier brand complementing Econo Lodge with focused essentials and low operating complexity.
fields.Brand Pillars:
Great savings — budget-first road travel positioning.

Travel basics — clean room, Wi-Fi, coffee, entertainment.

National brand trust — Choice distribution and loyalty.

Owner access — technology and franchise infrastructure.
fields.Brand History: Rodeway Inn from Choice Hotels operates more than 600 properties worldwide, covering travel basics for budget-conscious guests on the road.
fields.Guest Psychographics Description: Budget-conscious travelers who want functional, no-frills accommodations for short stops and road trips—prioritizing savings and reliability over extras.
fields.Key Brand Differentiators:
Good Night. Great Savings. brand line.

600+ global properties in economy segment.

Complimentary Wi-Fi and morning coffee standard.

Choice Privileges and distribution for owners and guests.
